item.title: Epstein survivor: ‘Virginia Giuffre is an American hero’
item.description: The survivors of Epstein's abuse say they are no closer to justice - despite the latest release of millions of files.

item.title: Gruffalo Granny: Julia Donaldson announces third book in series
item.description: The much loved Gruffalo books are to get another installment as author Julia Donaldson revealed the long awaited third in the series will come out this autumn. Gruffalo Granny will again feature illustrations by her long time collaborator Axel Scheffler. It’s been 20 years since the last book but Ms Donaldson said she had been…

item.title: Jon Ruben jailed 23 years for abusing boys at summer camp
item.description: A 76 year old man has been jailed for 23 years and 10 months for sexually abusing boys at a Christian summer camp in Leicestershire, after lacing sweets with sedative drugs purchased on the dark web.

item.title: 16-year-old died after using website promoting suicide
item.description: The parents of a 16-year-old boy who died in 2023 were horrified to find their son had been getting tips from a prolific user of a suicide website in the lead up to his death.

item.title: Trump sets new deadline to end Russia Ukraine war, says Zelenskyy
item.description: The US is pushing for Russia and Ukraine to end their war by June, according to President Zelenskyy.

item.title: ‘If we stop fighting, we’ll be erased’, says Ukrainian MP
item.description: We spoke to Oleksandr Merezhko, a Ukrainian MP from President Zelenskyy's party who is Chair of the Ukrainian parliament’s Foreign Affairs Committee.

item.title: Starmer in ‘serious’ situation amid Mandelson scandal, says Gordon Brown
item.description: Former Labour Prime Minister Gordon Brown has said that Sir Keir Starmer is in a 'serious' situation due to the fallout from his appointment of Peter Mandelson as US ambassador.

item.title: Will Mandelson scandal bring down Starmer?
item.description: We spoke to the Labour peer, and former special adviser to Gordon Brown, Baroness Ayesha Hazarika, and asked her just how bad this situation is for Keir Starmer?

item.title: Are UK flood warnings linked to ocean currents?
item.description: Record-breaking rainfall during January and no let-up in the downpours for many regions of the UK in February, means there are now 81 flood warnings across England and 11 more across Wales.

item.title: Comedian Josh Sharp’s PowerPoint approach to stand-up
item.description: If you were a performer wanting to create a more vibrant on-stage experience, a power point presentation might not be the first thing you'd go for.
